title: Future continuous, future perfect y in case

rule.title: Future continuous, future perfect (simple and continuous), in case
rule.explanation:
Future continuous («will be» + «-ing»): una acción que estará en curso en un momento del futuro:
- «This time tomorrow, I'll be standing on stage.»

Future perfect («will have» + participio): una acción que ya estará terminada antes de un momento del futuro:
- «By eleven o'clock, you'll have finished.»
- «By June, we'll have moved.»

Future perfect continuous («will have been» + «-ing»): cuánto tiempo llevará pasando algo en un momento del futuro:
- «By the time we arrive, we'll have been travelling for six hours.»

«By» + momento = para, antes de («by Friday», «by then»). «By the time» + presente = para cuando:
- «By the time we check in, it'll be dark.»

«In case» (por si acaso) + presente, aunque hable del futuro. No es lo mismo que «if»:
- «Take an umbrella in case it rains.» (llévatelo ya, por si llueve)
- «Take a taxi if it rains.» (solo si llueve)

rows: en curso en un momento futuro
I'll have been working here for a year.
Take a coat in case it's cold.

sets.instructions: Completa con «be», «have», «been», «by», «in case» o el participio.

items.sentence: This time tomorrow, I'll ___ standing in front of 400 designers.
answers: be
finished

items.sentence: I'll have ___ the demo by then. (send)
answers: sent

items.sentence: ___ the time we check in, it'll be dark.
answers: By

items.sentence: By six o'clock, we'll have ___ travelling for five hours.
answers: been

items.sentence: In June, Lucía will ___ been living in Bristol for three years.
answers: have

items.sentence: Take a printed copy ___ the laptop fails.
answers: in case

items.sentence: ___ the train is late, we'll take a taxi. (solo si pasa)
answers: If

items.sentence: Will you ___ using the car tonight?
answers: be

items.sentence: We'll have ___ the project by June. (finish)
answers: finished

items.sentence: I'll set two alarms in ___ I don't hear the first one.
answers: case

items.sentence: By next year, he'll have been ___ here for a decade. (work)
answers: working

items.sentence: Don't call at nine. I'll be ___ dinner. (have)
answers: having

items.sentence: By the end of the week, I'll have ___ all the reports. (read)
answers: read
